scope: Compare the installed GTK2 down-stepper pressed asset after R492 with the recorded Domain/OS SR10.4 held down-arrow glyph.

comparison.method: Read the current installed PNG and compare the centered 11x11 glyph at offset (2,2) against the recorded held-state semantic rows. Compare only L/D/F glyph pixels; exclude trough context and the recorded white cursor outside the arrow silhouette.
comparison.result: All 71 historical held-glyph pixels match the installed post-R492 pressed asset. The light/dark relief orientation is correct, and face pixels and silhouette are preserved. R51/R52/R480 separately document the GTK2 normal/held/release interaction contract; they do not replace direct native evidence for the remaining states.
